purpose: 外部核实档案：官方规则原文、历史获奖者公开画像、问题规模的第三方证据、竞品边界。本文件不是评分标尺；评分只按官方五维由独立评委给出，这里不预测名次、不自设分数线。

judging_criteria.name: Creativity
judging_criteria.quote: How fresh is the project idea or its use of Relate? Higher scores go to projects that present an original idea or an inventive way to use Relate.

judging_criteria.name: Relate and connected context
judging_criteria.quote: How effectively does the project use Relate's graph relationships to support its main use case? This includes how easily judges can use the submission of instructions, running, and exploring with Relate working as described.

judging_criteria.name: Functionality and completeness
judging_criteria.quote: How much of the project's core use case works?

judging_criteria.name: Usefulness
judging_criteria.quote: How clearly does the project address a real problem for an intended user? Who benefits and the does the project clearly show this.

judging_criteria.name: Documentation and reproducibility
judging_criteria.quote: How clearly does the README explain the project and how to try it?

readme_template_required_sections: How it uses Relate (Mode / Why this mode / What the graph models)
hard_requirements: Project description: the use case, and what connects to what
Public GitHub repo with README on how to set up and use it
Persistent Relate store: a directory or single file judges can inspect
Working code (or the prompts used) with Relate actually running
verbatim: Judges should be able to clone it, run it, and see your graph without asking you anything.
Entries that are only prompts or AI-generated text, with no running Relate integration, won't be considered.
Explore in the browser. Use the WebAssembly build to create interactive graph views, with nothing to install.

historical_winner_profiles.note: 公开来源的历史获奖画像，仅供工程对照；不是本作品的评分标尺，也不用于预测名次。
historical_winner_profiles.key_quote: The projects that rose to the top did so because they treated the graph as the intelligence, not just the storage layer.

winner_1_conspiracygraph.graph: 1,282 nodes / 2,436 relationships over real ClaimReview fact-check data
winner_1_conspiracygraph.why_won: It goes beyond true or false to explain how claims connect via narrative frames, entity bridges, and shared topics.
winner_1_conspiracygraph.judge_quote: Every media outlet should be considering an agent like this.

winner_pagerdruid.why_won: diagnoses incidents by reasoning over microservice dependency graphs; multi-hop dependencies, blast radius; standard RAG simply can't replicate
winner_pagerdruid.judge_quote: PagerDruid demonstrates exactly what graph powered agents can do. It uses relationships intentionally to diagnose complex systems and turns connected data into clear, explainable operational insight.

engineering_checklist_derived_from_winne: 图必须是推理主体：多跳/变长路径/motif 出现在主用例的每一次判定中，不是仅作存储
每条结论都要能展开成可解释的路径（explainable insight），而不只是布尔值
数据必须真实且可溯源（真实公开数据集 + 护照），并达到可探索的规模
Usefulness 要有可识别人群 + 真实高频问题 + 具体动作，且问题规模由外部证据而非自证支撑
评委一键 clone/run/see graph，无需提问

sca_boundary.status: 2026-11-23 本轮 WebSearch 已核实输入面；相邻方向已占；本检索未发现直接同题材产品（不等于不存在）

verified_input_surface.finding: SCA reads package manifests, lockfiles, SBOMs, container images or built artifacts; it matches component versions against vulnerability databases. None of the four sources lists agent natural-language answers as an input.

items.name: FossID Agentic SCA
items.overlap: exposes SCA as MCP tools/skills to agents; still operates on code/components, not the agent's sentence

items.name: Sonatype AI dependency guidance
items.overlap: current component intelligence at dependency-choice time; component-level, not claim-level with evidence chain

items.name: Labrador AI-written component misuse
items.overlap: version misuse / policy on manifests and lockfiles; no natural-language claim provenance

items.name: IBM NLP on commit messages
items.overlap: partial: NLP applied to version-control text, but for commit issues, not dependency-version claims with a public-vulnerability clock

sca_boundary.not_found_in_this_search: No product found that treats an agent's natural-language version declaration as the audited input, walks a multi-hop evidence chain to the source document, and applies the advisory publication clock to decide whether the sentence was born stale. This is a search result, not an existence proof.
sca_boundary.author_judgment: Claim the WINDOW (before the text is merged) and the INPUT (the sentence, not the lockfile), never the category SCA. The differentiator is a graph-native multi-hop join + time counterfactual; a clean lockfile coexists with a born-stale claim in the same run.
